Ultragenyx agreed to sell a Priority Review Voucher (PRV) for $203 million; the voucher was granted following FDA approval of FAYUVI (rebisufligene etisparvovec-hopf, also known as UX111)

catalysts.headline: Agreed to sell a second Priority Review Voucher for $210 million (announcement, not yet closed as of this report), this one tied to the Genglycos (DTX401) approval for glycogen storage disease type Ia; buyer undisclosed, sale subject to Hart-Scott-Rodino and other customary closing conditions. Combined with the Oct 14 FAYUVI-linked PRV sale, the two deals total roughly $413M.
catalysts.impact: Non-dilutive cash inflow of $210M upon closing
